messages:
Maria: Heads-up — HyperNova sent over a new model we need to onboard: quetzal-13B-v1. S3: s3://redwood-partners/hypernova/quetzal-13b-v1/manifest.json. Please run the full intake/provenance checks (weights + tokenizer) and create registry metadata. High priority for Dedicated trial + quantization experiments.
Aj: Thanks. Priority level? target deploy modes (hosted/dedicated/private)?
Maria: Priority = P1 (Dedicated trial first). Deploy modes allowed = dedicated, private (no hosted until legal clears license). Quant targets = AWQ 4-bit + 8-bit GPTQ baseline. Eval suites: instruction-following, MMLU, perplexity, code generation subset, latency bench.
Tom: Checklist I usually run: 
  - verify sha256/size matches manifest
  - verify signature (if provided)
  - tokenizer vocab/version + special tokens match model config
  - safetensors/ckpt format sanity (no tied weights issues)
  - minimal example load on CPU/GPU
Snippet: ```sha256sum quetzal-13b-v1.safetensors```
S3 copy: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-partners/hypernova/quetzal-13b-v1/weights.safetensors ./```
S3 manifest compare: ```jq .sha256 manifest.json```
Sasha: add: run convert integrity check (we've seen weights with missing metadata before):
```python tools/convert_to_safetensors.py --check-integrity s3://.../weights.safetensors```
And check tokenizer special tokens: ```python tools/check_tokenizer.py --vocab s3://.../tokenizer.json```
Ken: For registry metadata please include these keys: model_name, model_version, source_uri, checksum_sha256, signer, license, tokenizer_version, tokenizer_hash, quant_candidates, allowed_deploy_modes, legal_clearance, kms_key_id. Use storage class INTELLIGENT_TIERING and enable object-lock on the s3 prefix for 1 year retention. Also tag objects with `provenance=partner-ingest`.
Maria: Eval config notes: use eval_prompt_set=v2 (covers instruction-following + safety), seed=42 for deterministic scoring runs, production sampling config for rollout (temp=0.2, top_p=0.95) and fixed logits-warmup when comparing quantized vs fp16. Target perf: P99 < 150ms for single-stream 128-token prompt on Dedicated 1xA100-80G; capture throughput/latency curves.
Priya: License question — HyperNova's manifest shows "proprietary-commercial" with redistribution restrictions. Need Legal sign-off before any hosted/permissive rollout. I'll take point on the legal thread.
deploy-bot: intake ticket created: ML-4872. Linked JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-4872
Tom: Quantization experiment plan (short):
  1) baseline FP16 run w/ eval sets (MMLU, code, instr-follow)
  2) run 8-bit GPTQ, capture per-task delta
  3) run AWQ 4-bit, capture per-task delta and per-layer stats (min/max/scale)
  4) compare perplexity + instruction-following accuracy + subset of safety evals
Commands: ```python experiments/quantize.py --model s3://redwood-partners/hypernova/quetzal-13b-v1 --algo awq --bits 4 --out /tmp/q4/```
Sasha: Gating rule proposal: if instruction-following score drops > 2% absolute OR safety/toxicity metric regresses beyond threshold then block rollout. Also add a small human-in-the-loop spot check for 30 prompts (edge-case/long-context).
Ken: Security checklist: ensure objects encrypted with KMS (kms_key_id arn:aws:kms:...), enable bucket logging, sign final artifact with cosign/gpg and store signature in registry metadata as signer=gpg:hypernova@example.com. Add cosign blob to s3://redwood-partners/hypernova/quetzal-13b-v1/signature.cosign
Maria: OK assigning: Tom -> weight integrity + baseline FP16 evals. Sasha -> quant experiments (AWQ/GPQT8) + gating thresholds. Priya -> legal/license + partner CLARIFICATIONS. Ken -> registry metadata, bucket policy, KMS, signatures. Aj -> schedule Dedicated bench runs and reserve capacity. Deadline: one week (next Fri).
Tom: I'll start with sha256 and signature check now, will post results here. :thumbsup:
Sasha: I'll spin up experiments and push configs to ML repo under experiments/quetzal-13b-v1/
Priya: I'll ping Legal and loop back with required contract addenda.
Ken: Created registry entry draft at: registry.internal/models/quetzal/13b/v1 — will attach manifest + signer + kms id.
Maria: Thanks team. Keep thread updated with short status posts. If anything blocks, flag in ML-4872.
deploy-bot: automated note: attach bucket lifecycle policy to ML-4872.
